Mumbai Park Tree Felling Sparks Dispute Amid Coastal Road Project

The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has begun felling 184 trees at Nana Nani Park in Mumbai to facilitate the Coastal Road project. This action has led to a dispute, with residents lodging over 3,200 objections. The felling proceeded despite these protests.
